_doc: Reviewed overrides for the full-text company layer (scripts/build_companies.py). Keys of include/exclude are candidate keys from output/company_candidates.csv. merge maps a node name (any spelling) to the canonical node name; when the canonical is a KG organization, the company extends that node. rename maps a candidate key to a display name. Numbered funds and trusts (Apollo IV/V/VI, 2006/2011 trusts) are separate entities and are not merged. seeds: entities written without a legal form, found by full-text phrase search (name, phrases, kind, relevance; join = existing node to extend). relevance maps a candidate key to a reviewed relevance (epstein_controlled/network/incidental). Opaque company IDs are also accepted in merge when both groups already exist; missing ID targets never rename or create a group.

merge_notes.APO I Trust: Spelling of the APO-01 Trust (I for 1).
